answer: What survives to the gale is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. The copper is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the basalt. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
